invariants.rationale: A write client is required to perform any operations; unlikely this method would be called with a null client.
A valid instant time is required for committing, so it should be non-null and non-empty.
preppedRecordInputs is used immediately, so it must not be null.
Option objects are used to represent optional values, but the Option instance itself should not be null.
The parameter is declared as a List<HoodieRecord>; verifying type coherence.
